pages.title: Ecosphere
pages.text: A sealed glass sphere of soil, water, plants and creatures, lit and warmed, a whole living world kept in balance.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the predator and prey stocking. The cycle is Lotka-Volterra; the prey settle near g/d and the predators near a/b, but stocked too far off the cycle swings wider until one side crashes. Both must stay above a tenth of their balance.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Stable Ecosystem, Symbiont Lining, Tree of Life.
